question: When lead nitrate is heated, lead oxide, oxygen gas and a brown mysterious gas are formed. What is that mysterious gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**nitrogen dioxide**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitrogen dioxide** (NO₂) is the mysterious brown gas formed when lead nitrate is heated.
 
• The chemical reaction involved is:
 
 2Pb(NO₃)₂ (s) → 2PbO (s) + 4NO<sub
